sn_aia_tool.description: Retrieves and analyzes Food Complaint Task records from the Campus Food Services Assistant application for management reporting. Analyze task count, Current Priority, Student Count, State, Assignment Group, Problem Type, Approval, Use Case Number, Mess Hall, Meal Type, and Priority Reason. Return only information retrieved from the application. Do not invent missing data or unsupported conclusions.
sn_aia_tool.name: Food Complaint Task Analytics
